title: You're not getting a Trad Wife
summary: A Valentine's Day dating rant arguing that the 'trad wife' (virgin, young, pretty, wants kids and to stay home, obedient) is a near-impossible unicorn in modern society. NH argues women are hyper-conformists who follow social incentives, that modern men are no more traditional than modern women, and that the only answer is to become a high-value man worthy of such a woman and 'build' a traditional partner by example.
claims: A trad wife is defined as a virgin before marriage who wants kids and to be a stay-at-home mother from the start, is subservient, pretty and young
Historically virginity mattered biologically because it was the only way for a man to be sure a child was his own offspring
Studies show women with fewer sexual partners divorce less and report happier relationships, but this may partly reflect lack of comparison rather than better marriages
Men who insist on an inexperienced partner may do so out of insecurity or a desire to control someone with no point of comparison; a man should aim to be the best catch instead
He has never once worried about a partner leaving him for another man, which he attributes to confidence and treating her well
He accepts double standards between the sexes because men and women differ biologically and psychologically, but thinks men should be held to much higher standards
Sex affects women more than men biologically (pregnancy) and psychologically (stronger attachment to partners), which is why the lock-and-key analogy is not entirely wrong
Birth control, media normalisation of hookups and the commodification of sex mean traditional chastity standards can no longer be expected of women
Men are only as virtuous as their options; most men would also chase easy pleasure if it were available, and porn use is the male equivalent
Women are hyper-conformists who follow social trends; traditional women of the past followed patriarchal norms because it gave them the best life, not out of inherent virtue
To convince anyone to change behaviour you must articulate concretely why it benefits them and show the future consequences, not just call things good or bad
Modern feminism was pushed largely to bring women into the workforce and grow capital, not to make them happier
The modern cost of living means one salary rarely supports a family, making a return to the traditional single-earner household difficult
You won't get a trad wife mainly because modern men are not traditional themselves
Heterofatalism: highly educated, high-earning women rarely date men below them, so giving women choice raised their standards to the point many price themselves out of a husband
Men who demand a trad wife usually prioritise her attractiveness above her virtue, which is itself untraditional
A trad wife depends on her husband for everything; wanting only obedience is wanting a slave, and it is a trait of a weak man to seek a weak woman
Setting an impossible standard like the perfect trad wife is a way to justify inaction and self-sabotage; become the unicorn instead of hunting one
Trad wives are built, not born: most men will end up with a modern woman and must embody traditional values well enough that following him gives her a better life
Having kids is the optimal choice for a woman, fulfilling a biological imperative and securing a provider and later children to care for her
The only way to get a woman to want kids with you is to become high value; work on yourself until you are attractive enough that someone attaches herself to you
viewer_questions: how do I get a trad wife
